name: PS5 FSR4 Showcase
description: Experimental FSR 4.1.1 showcase and benchmarking tool for PS5 homebrew. Demonstrates native Vulkan compute upscaling with multiple quality modes at 1080p, 1440p and 4K, split-screen comparisons against bilinear and native rendering, magnification views and built-in performance benchmarks.
author: BlackBearReloaded
